title: ScanWise
subtitle: AI-Powered Career Assistant
desc: Reads a resume and a job description, then scores the match, lists matched and missing skills and gives personalised recommendations. A Next.js dashboard turns the AI analysis into clear next steps, backed by FastAPI and PostgreSQL services with streaming AI responses.

title: Balcony PV Detection
subtitle: M.Sc. Thesis, Saarland University
desc: A computer vision pipeline that detects balcony solar panels in street-level imagery. It samples locations along OpenStreetMap roads, fetches Google Street View images and validates detections against the MaStR registry, mapping them to support local energy-grid planning.

title: HEALY
subtitle: Saarland University
desc: An LLM agent built with Mistral and LangGraph that explains healthcare cost predictions from the SPARCS dataset, using SHAP to surface the key cost drivers. Evaluated with a RAG-based G-Eval pipeline at about 0.95 precision.

title: LearnAid
subtitle: Saarland University
desc: A React Native AI tutoring app, built by a small team I led. An LLM feedback layer gives personalised guidance based on how learners perform, and a recommendation engine builds learning paths from their progress.
